translations.web: He won’t break a bruised reed. He won’t quench a smoking flax, until he leads justice to victory.
translations.bsb: A bruised reed He will not break, and a smoldering wick He will not extinguish, till He leads justice to victory.
translations.kjv: A bruised reed shall he not break, and smoking flax shall he not quench, till he send forth judgment unto victory.
translations.asv: A bruised reed shall he not break, And smoking flax shall he not quench, Till he send forth judgment unto victory.
